# Banner credits

## Artwork

The foundry scene in `maestro-core.jpg` was generated using artificial
intelligence: FLUX.2 [dev] (NVFP4) running locally in ComfyUI, 28 steps,
guidance 3.5, Euler sampler, 2560 x 1024, seed 4903. It was reviewed and
approved before publication.

How it was made:

1. Text-to-image, seed 4903, selected from eight candidates.
2. Approved local edits: the left 45% emptied to near-black with a soft
   transition, and the star's diagonal flares removed, keeping its four
   cardinal rays.
3. Finishing: HTML typography over the polished artwork, exported to PNG,
   then converted to JPEG at the full 2560 x 1024 resolution.

Model stack: `flux2-dev-nvfp4.safetensors`, `mistral_3_small_flux2_fp4_mixed.safetensors`,
`flux2-vae.safetensors`. The FLUX [dev] Model is licensed by Black Forest Labs Inc.
under the FLUX [dev] Non-Commercial License; Black Forest Labs claims no ownership of
outputs.

The image is a fictional, cinematic illustration, not a photograph of an
actual foundry. Generation provenance is retained by the maintainers.

## Type

The title, tagline and labels are set in HTML, not generated:

- **DejaVu Serif Bold**: the title.
- **DejaVu Sans**: the tagline.
- **DejaVu Sans Mono**: the labels.

These [DejaVu fonts](https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html) use the
Bitstream Vera font licence; DejaVu changes are in the public domain.
The embedded DejaVu Sans font also carries the permissive Arev font notice
for imported glyphs. Font notices are retained with the banner's source
package; no font files are distributed here.
